title: SentinelStaff
description: SentinelStaff is a lightweight, powerful admin utility plugin designed for modern Paper servers (1.21–1.21.x).Built for performance. Designed for control.
body:
🔥 Features

✔ Freeze system with logout detection
✔ Smart vanish (no mob targeting, silent join/quit)
✔ Staff chat
✔ Random teleport check
✔ Report system with file storage
✔ Admin GUI panel
✔ Action logging
✔ Fully configurable messages
✔ Optimized for Paper

⚡ Why SentinelStaff?

Unlike bloated admin plugins, SentinelStaff focuses on:

• Clean code
• No unnecessary features
• High performance
• Modern Paper compatibility
• Fully customizable configuration

📦 Commands

/freeze
/unfreeze
/vanish
/visible
/sc
/report
/adminpanel
/ultrastaff reload

🔐 Permissions

sentinelstaff.*
sentinelstaff.freeze
sentinelstaff.vanish
sentinelstaff.staffchat
sentinelstaff.report
sentinelstaff.panel

🧩 Compatibility

✔ Paper 1.21.x
✔ Java 17+
✘ Not tested on Spigot
